description:
Intetics Inc. is a leading American technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and "all-things-digital" solutions, is looking for a Senior Data Support Engineer to enrich its team with a skilled professional.

Requirements

  • Must to have at least 5-6 years of experience with Data Engineering
  • Must to have at least 5-6 years of experience with Snowflake, Python, SSIS, SQL Server, DBT, AWS
  • Proven track record as a Data Engineer with demonstrable experience in projects and solutions you've delivered
  • Must to have at least 5 -6 years of experience with SQL for complex data manipulation, transformation, and analysis
  • Must to have at least 5 -6 years of experience with dbt core or dbt Cloud
  • Must to have at least 5-6 years of experience with snowflake
  • Must to have at least 5 -6years of experience with Python for scripting and custom data ingestion
  • Must to have at least 5 -6 years of experience with data modelling, ELT development, and data warehousing techniques
  • Must to have at least 5 -6 years of experience with Git and GitHub Pull Request
  • Must to have at least 5 -6 years of experience with supporting QA and User Acceptance Testing processes

Would be a plus:

  • Good to have experience with GitHub Action
  • Good to have experience with Fivetran
  • Good to have experience with Terraform
  • Good to have experience with with AWS cloud services, particularly (e.g., AWS Lambda, S3 and ECS).
  • Good to have experience with Power BI
  • Good to have experience with Azure Data Factory and Logic Apps
  • Good to have experience with the entertainment or ticketing industry
  • Good to have experience of data protection laws such as GDPR, CCPA and SOX
